name: manual_a0ffc2
claim: CI status belongs to one exact head: re-check it after every push, and never carry a green result from an earlier commit or from the development machine to the new head; read the failing job log before concluding what broke.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19 orama-system#423: 26 checks were green on one head and the next head failed two tests on Linux CI; reading the log showed a case-sensitivity cause that the macOS run could not show.

rationale: 2026-10-19 orama-system#423: 26 checks were green on one head and the next head failed two tests on Linux CI; reading the log showed a case-sensitivity cause that the macOS run could not show.
